commit.message:
feat(render): composite annotation appearances onto the page

The rasterizer drew page content only, so highlights, stamps, notes and form
widgets were missing from every rendered page. Place each visible annotation's
/AP /N by fitting its /Matrix-transformed /BBox to /Rect per ISO 32000-1 12.5.5,
resolve appearance states through /AS, and skip Hidden/NoView and Popup.
draw_annotations=False keeps the content-only behaviour.
